scope_statement: User-discovered Modify sampled-passivity and smoothing defects in Insertion Loss Tool.

escaped_defects.user_symptom: Changing Modify target frequencies repeatedly fails with a passive error, including the bundled default example and default targets.
escaped_defects.failure_mechanism: Bundled examples predated the quadrature-reflection fix, and unconstrained Gaussian RBF smoothing could overshoot into negative insertion loss between feasible targets.
